lf-file.description: An automatically saved editor for one explicitly bound UTF-8 file on the serving machine. CodeMirror owns editing and inline conflict comparison; the file is external state, outside Leaf's action log.
lf-file.x-instructions: Author an empty element and bind its binding id to a real file with leaf file bind PAGE BINDING PATH. Tell the reader that edits save automatically. Ordinary typing is visually quiet; delayed saves, errors and external conflicts explain themselves. A page without a local binding shows an unavailable diagnostic: use lf-code when the reader should see a portable snapshot instead.
